description: A checker: says whether a run's work is good by a command, run in a copy of the project as the run left it. Named as a run's checkWith; its own arguments are `command` (npm test) and `seconds` (600), beside what a runner hands a checker.

returns.ok: boolean: whether the command ended well, in time
returns.notes: string: how it ended, and the end of what it printed

input.prompt: A checker: says whether a run's work is good by a command, run in a copy of the project as the run left it.
